sets.name: Identity Mismatch Demo
sets.description: 3 synthetic documents (Aadhaar, PAN, Birth Certificate) demonstrating a name mismatch between PAN and the other two documents, plus a year-only DOB on the Birth Certificate.
sets.scenario: Consensus on name from Aadhaar + Birth Certificate, PAN has a different spelling. Full DOB on Aadhaar & PAN, year-only on Birth Certificate.

sets.name: Demo Set: Name & DOB Mismatch
sets.description: 3 synthetic documents (Ration Card, Aadhaar Card, Driving Licence) for Sanjay Prakash Patil demonstrating a DOB conflict and name initial format variation.
sets.scenario: Ration Card & Aadhaar agree on DOB 14/06/1995 while Driving Licence has 22/09/1994. Aadhaar and Driving Licence have full name Sanjay Prakash Patil while Ration Card has S. P. Patil.
